# Abetworks

> Abetworks (Abet Works) is an integrated AI business suite for teams that sell, serve and scale — NuCRM, LeadGenius, LeadWorks, AbetConnect, AbetAgent, AbetFlow, AbetAnalytics and AbetAPI — plus 100+ free tools, built and supported from Mumbai, India. Every product is sold standalone and connects to the rest through API keys and signed webhooks. From $19/month with a 14-day free trial on every paid product.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2023 · Headquarters: 301, VS Road, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Founder & CEO: Vinayak Sonawane
- Products: 9 in the suite · Native integrations: 120+ · Service practices: 6
- Pricing: NuCRM from $19/user/mo · LeadGenius $29/user/mo · LeadWorks $49/mo · AbetConnect $24/agent/mo · AbetAgent $99/mo · AbetAnalytics $19/mo · AbetFlow, AbetAPI and Abetworks Tools are $0
- Billing: USD or INR with GST · annual billing saves 20% · platform fees (WhatsApp/SMS/telephony/model usage) passed through at cost
- Trials: 14 days on every paid product; card required at sign-up, cancel anytime in the billing portal · free migration on Growth plans and above
- Data: residency in Mumbai (ap-south-1), Frankfurt and N. Virginia · GDPR and India DPDP Act ready · ISO 27001-aligned controls · SOC 2 Type II programme · signed DPA and sub-processor register
- Languages: interfaces in English, Hindi, Marathi; AI drafting in 30+ languages
- Customers: India, GCC, Southeast Asia, United Kingdom, United States
- Contact: admin@abetworks.in

## Products

- [NuCRM](https://abetworks.in/products/nucrm/): The flagship AI CRM — scores every lead in under 30 seconds, drafts the next touch, shows managers where the pipeline is leaking. From $19/user/month.
- [LeadGenius](https://abetworks.in/products/leadgenius/): AI sales engagement and multichannel outreach with sending warmup and deliverability guardrails, so cold email lands where it should. $29/user/month.
- [LeadWorks](https://abetworks.in/products/leadworks/): Lead operations workspace — capture every lead once (duplicates refused at the door), with validation, dedupe and CRM-ready CSV exports. $49/month.
- [AbetConnect](https://abetworks.in/products/abetconnect/): Customer conversations workspace — one ranked omnichannel inbox; every message scored 0–100 so churn risks and high-value enquiries rise to the top. $24/agent/month.
- [AbetAgent](https://abetworks.in/products/abetagent/): AI agents that cite their sources, keep a step trace of what they did, and escalate to a human when a task needs one. $99/month.
- [AbetFlow](https://abetworks.in/products/abetflow/): Workflow glue — an inbound webhook starts a multi-step run, steps call your endpoints, and every completed run publishes a signed webhook. $0 — included with the suite.
- [AbetAnalytics](https://abetworks.in/products/abetanalytics/): Product analytics — scheduled metric snapshots, alert rules that stay silent when healthy, alerts by email and by signed webhooks. $19/month or $190/year.
- [AbetAPI](https://abetworks.in/products/abetapi/): Developer platform — scoped API keys, events, signed webhook deliveries with retries, SSO, and the NuCRM inbound bridge. $0 — included with the suite.
- [Abetworks Tools](https://abetworks.in/products/abet-tools/): 100+ free browser-based utilities, no signup, nothing leaves the browser. Free forever.

- [Implementation](https://abetworks.in/implementation/): Live in 5–10 working days; named onboarding specialist for 30 days.

- [Abetworks Tools](https://tools.abetworks.in/): 100+ free web tools (text, developer, calculators, SEO, security, business, marketing), no signup required.

Nothing on the hub is purchasable yet — paid tiers are planned.
